interconnect_topology_options: Shared address buses and multiple data buses (recommended balance)
Multilayer, with multiple address and data buses

interconnect_id_handling.id_widening: When a master is connected to an interconnect, the interconnect appends additional bits to ARID/AWID/WID that are unique to that master port. ID at slave interface is wider than at master interface.
interconnect_id_handling.id_routing: For read data, interconnect uses the appended bits of RID to determine which master port the data is destined for. Interconnect removes these bits before passing RID to the master. Same scheme for BID.

interconnect_ordering_requirements: A read R1 request must be issued before a read R2 request, where R2 is received after R1, with the same ID and to the same or overlapping locations.
A write W1 request must be issued before a write W2 request, where W2 is received after W1, with the same ID, to the same or overlapping locations.
A Device read DR1 request must be issued before a Device read DR2 request, where DR2 is received after DR1, with the same ID and to the same Peripheral region.
A Device write DW1 request must be issued before a Device write DW2 request, where DW2 is received after DW1, with the same ID and to the same Peripheral region.
A read R1 response must be issued before a read R2 response, where R2 is received after R1, with the same ID.
A write W1 response must be issued before a write W2 response, where W2 is received after W1, with the same ID.
Any manipulation of the AXI ID values associated with a transaction must ensure that the ordering requirements of the original ID values are maintained.
fields.default_slave_behavior: When the interconnect cannot decode a slave access, it must return DECERR. Spec recommends routing to a default slave that returns DECERR.

slave_classification.Memory_slave: Must handle all transaction types correctly.
slave_classification.Peripheral_slave: Has an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED method of access (described in the datasheet). Any access outside the defined method must still complete (no system deadlock) but correct functional behavior is not guaranteed.

Regular_attribute_criteria: AxSIZE is same as data bus width if AxLEN > 1
AxBURST is INCR or WRAP (not FIXED)
AxADDR aligned to the transaction container for INCR
AxADDR aligned to AxSIZE for WRAP
regular_transactions_property.Regular_Transactions_Only_property: Can be TRUE for AXI5/ACE5/ACE5-Lite/ACE5-LiteDVM. If TRUE: only Regular transactions supported. If not declared, considered False.
regular_transactions_property.interoperability_table: Master=False + Slave=True is NOT compatible (may cause corruption or deadlock).

ordered_write_observation_property.True: Slave gives stronger guarantees: W1 is observed by W2 (issued after W1 from same master with same ID) regardless of destination/address.
ordered_write_observation_property.False: Default; standard AXI ordering rules apply.
ordered_write_observation_property.use_case: Allows masters using Producer-Consumer model to issue dependent writes without waiting for first write completion.

multi_copy_atomicity_property.True: Required for systems with Arm v8 architecture processors (Load-Acquire / Store-Release require multi-copy atomicity).
multi_copy_atomicity_property.True_required: Issue G and later require Multi_Copy_Atomicity = True.

fields.default_signal_values_when_omitted: See Table A9-1..A9-4 (master write, slave write, master read, slave read). Examples: AWBURST defaults to INCR; AWSIZE defaults to data bus width; AWCACHE defaults to 0b0000; WSTRB defaults to all-ones; AWLOCK defaults to Normal.
interface_categories: Read/Write interface (AR, R, AW, W, B)
Read-only interface (AR, R only; no exclusive support)
Write-only interface (AW, W, B only; no exclusive support)
fields.register_slice_insertion_rule: A register slice can be inserted at almost any point in any channel, at the cost of an additional cycle of latency. Each channel transfers info in only one direction with no fixed inter-channel relationship.
fields.axi4_lite_subset: AXI4-Lite is a subset of AXI4 for simpler control-register-style interfaces (defined in Part B). AXI5-Lite is the AXI5 equivalent.

evidence.quote: Each AXI channel transfers information in only one direction, and the architecture does not require any fixed relationship between the channels. These qualities mean that a register slice can be inserted at almost any point in any channel, at the cost of an additional cycle of latency.

evidence.spec_section: A5.2.3 Interconnect use of transaction identifiers
evidence.quote: When a master is connected to an interconnect, the interconnect appends additional bits to the ARID, AWID and WID identifiers that are unique to that master port.

A read R1 request must be issued before a read R2 request, where R2 is received after R1, with the same ID and to the same or overlapping locations. ... Any manipulation of the AXI ID values that are associated with a transaction must ensure that the ordering requirements of the original ID values are maintained.

An interface that exhibits Ordered Write Observation gives guarantees for write transactions that are not dependent on the destination or address: A write W1 is guaranteed to be observed by a write W2, where W2 is issued after W1, from the same master, with the same ID.

It is required that the Multi_Copy_Atomicity property is True for Issue G and later of this specification. A system must have the Multi_Copy_Atomicity property if Arm v8 Architecture processors are used.
The Regular_Transactions_Only property can be True for the following interfaces: AXI5, ACE5, ACE5-Lite, ACE5-LiteDVM. Interoperability: Master=False + Slave=True is not compatible.

A read-only interface supports only read transactions and includes AR, R. A write-only interface supports only write transactions and includes AW, W, B. A read-only interface does not support exclusive accesses.

evidence.spec_section: A9.3 Default signal values / Table A9-1
evidence.quote: AWBURST default 0b01 INCR. AWSIZE default Data bus width. AWCACHE default 0b0000. AWQOS default 0b0000. WSTRB default All ones.
